messages:
sarah.k: FYI I uploaded the NovaX-13B checkpoint tarball to S3 at s3://redwood-models/incoming/novaX/2026-03-16/novaX-13b.tar.gz — size ~26GB. Please do not run conversions until we confirm shard layout.
jake: got it. what layout did the supplier use? TP or single-shard?
sarah.k: they sent TP-aware shards: files named novaX_tp{0..1}_shard{0..3}.pt (total 8 files). looks like tensor-parallel=2, tp_shards=4 each.
anya: quick check: our conversion script expects TP layout like `tp_{rank}/shard_{part}.bin` — we should map names. can you list the exact file names?
sarah.k: here:
```
novaX_tp0_shard0.pt
novaX_tp0_shard1.pt
novaX_tp0_shard2.pt
novaX_tp0_shard3.pt
novaX_tp1_shard0.pt
novaX_tp1_shard1.pt
novaX_tp1_shard2.pt
novaX_tp1_shard3.pt
```
mohammad: noted. conversion plan: run safetensors conversion with `scripts/convert_to_safetensors.py --input-s3 s3://redwood-models/incoming/novaX/... --out s3://redwood-models/converted/novaX/2026-03-16/ --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --parts 4 --map-names tp{n}_shard{m}`. I'll prepare a mapping file just in case.
todd: small heads-up — tokenizer from supplier had a merged unknown token ID > vocab_size in their config.json last time. please validate `vocab_size` and `added_tokens`.
sarah.k: good catch. I ran `jq .vocab_size config.json` and it returns 50256. but `added_tokens` contains 4 custom tokens, and one of them has id 50256 in toks.json (off-by-one).
anya: that's the exact quirk. we should rewrite the tokenizer mapping before packaging. script: `python tooling/fix_tokenizer_ids.py --config config.json --tokens toks.json --out fixed_tokens.json` — will update PR after I run it.
jake: also double-check dtype: supplier weights are bf16 but lossless export requires fp16. conversion needs `--cast-to fp16` and then run validation run to compare a few logits. include a small unit test: `python tests/compare_logits.py --ref s3://.../ref_logits.npz --new ./converted/sample_logits.npz`
mohammad: for sharding naming, I'll emit SAFETENSORS shards named `novaX-13b.tp{tp_rank}.part{part}.safetensors` and create a manifest `manifest.json` with keys: `tp`, `part`, `sha256`, `file_size`, `dtype`.
sarah.k: please include original-file-pointer in manifest (S3 path + etag) so we can trace back.
deploy-bot: conversion-job queued: job_id=conv-20260316-42, started by mohammad. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/conv-20260316-42
mohammad: started step1: download shards. ETA ~6m.
anya: I'll open a tiny PR for tokenizer fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/324 — contains the id-fix and a small test. please review when free. :eyes:
jake: pinged in the PR. one request: add an assertion that `max(token_ids) < vocab_size` in the test.
sarah.k: conversion step2 done: cast to fp16 and combined into safetensors per tp rank. uploading to s3://redwood-models/converted/novaX/2026-03-16/ now.
mohammad: checksum step: computing sha256 for each safetensors file.
todd: quick config validation: run `python tooling/validate_model_config.py --config config.json --expected-embed-dim 8192 --expected-layers 40` — we've had mismatch cases before.
mohammad: validation output:
```
config.json: OK
vocab_size: mismatch (config:50256, toks.json max_id:50256) -> fixed in PR
embed_dim: 8192 OK
num_layers: 40 OK
tp_layout: expected 2, found inferred 2 OK
```
sarah.k: re: serving readiness, we need to decide canary policy: run dedicated pool test with 2 qps for 10 minutes, then ramp to 20 qps. who can own the canary?
anya: I can own the canary. will schedule a canary run on staging dedicated later today.
jake: after canary, we should run a smoke eval with 20 prompts from our prompt-suite to check generation quality vs ref. I'll add it to the canary job.
mohammad: upload finished, manifest posted at s3://redwood-models/converted/novaX/2026-03-16/manifest.json, job conv-20260316-42 completed. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/conv-20260316-42/console
sarah.k: thanks all. next steps: anya will run tokenizer PR, mohammad will push final manifest to model-catalog, jake will prepare canary + eval job, todd will sign off config validation.
anya: starting tokenizer PR deploy to staging now. will report back in this thread with results.
todd: I'll run a quick local sample generation against the converted model and post the first/last token logits diff.
jake: OK — tagging ops for scheduled canary window 1600-1630 PST. @ops-team please standby. :wave:
sarah.k: closing loop: please add your thumbs in thread when done so we can mark the model onboarding ticket resolved. :+1:
mohammad: :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup: PR merged, tokenizer fixed. staged canary scheduled.
todd: local smoke pass OK, logits diff < 1e-3 on sample prompts.
jake: canary started 1600 PST. monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/mon/models/novaX/canary
deploy-bot: canary-checkpoint: conv-20260316-42 -> canary-20260316-7 started.
sarah.k: amazing work team — leaving notes in the model ticket with links. I'll mark first_message_ts/last_message_ts on the ticket accordingly.
anya: done — posting final checklist in the ticket and closing once the canary fully succeeds. :party:
